channels.notes: Published Relay v1.5.0 defines the container-image evidence profile. The current manual workflow reviews local source and bundles; it does not publish a release.

GHCR or Docker Hub publication is a separate repository-owned adapter requiring reviewed native multi-architecture image evidence, cryptographic verification and explicit publication approval. No registry image is claimed.

rollback.instructions: Keep exact vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tags, recorded OCI index/platform digests and evidence bytes immutable. Stop discovery-channel promotion for an affected digest, document revocation, and update consumers by reviewed change to a previously verified digest or a corrective successor. Never retag an existing version or overwrite an earlier bundle. See docs/releasing.md for partial-publication recovery and retention.
